additional_observations.repro_193: GT alpha cleans background disparity/fragments and changes foreground depth repair and LaMa fill. Final PSNR nevertheless decreases0.337257dB versus full-public and FD worsens0.105294. No gross focus reversal or channel swap seen; retain the regression, not a monotone benefit claim.
additional_observations.repro_160: Person stays sharp and lion stays defocused in all three outputs at sampled frames. Known-layer output changes sheep/lion appearance and blur-boundary mixing; PSNR drops2.475994dB versus GTalpha. No new gross frame/order failure observed. The changed layer structure/hidden information and renderer response prevent unique attribution.
additional_observations.repro_101: Focused man and strongly defocused animals remain correctly ordered at sampled frames. Masks, repaired depths and LaMa backgrounds visibly differ; known layers retain contrast/blur/occlusion differences from reference. FD worsens0.154335 versus GTalpha and0.456109 versus full-public. Five keyframes do not identify the cause of flow-metric differences or rule out unsampled flicker.

limits: No claim to recover Any-to-Bokeh private adapter.
Known layers are not a guaranteed per-scene upper bound or pure LaMa ablation.
K groups have different content; descriptive improvements are not an isolated causal test.
Fixed200 reproduction development, not an official/held-out benchmark.

post_review_reporting_selection.rationale: Current stage prioritizes reconstruction of the Any-to-Bokeh synthetic/Table1 performance landscape. On the fixed same200 scenes, GT-alpha robustly improves the full-public result and restores the reported Dr.Bokeh metric scale much more closely (PSNR 31.588505 vs paper 31.273; FVD 25.859006 vs paper 32.710).
post_review_reporting_selection.scope: Reporting/reproduction selection only. It does not establish that the Any-to-Bokeh private Dr.Bokeh adapter used GT alpha. Full-public remains the public complete-pipeline result and is the preferred starting candidate when constructing a future fair benchmark with unified information permissions. Known layers remain diagnostic.
post_review_reporting_selection.freeze_rule: Selected before Ours evaluation. Do not change the Dr.Bokeh Track A reporting adapter based on Ours results; only objective implementation errors may trigger correction.
future_stage_logic: First evaluate Ours against Any-to-Bokeh on the frozen ATB-style reproduction benchmark.
Then construct an independent project benchmark with unified RGB/low-FPS coarse-depth/focus/control permissions and OPPO-style degradations.
Re-select fair baseline adapters for that independent benchmark; do not automatically carry GT-alpha privileges into it.
